entities.name: Political Instability and International Isolation
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: After Boyer's overthrow in 1843, Haiti experienced chronic political instability with frequent coups and short-lived presidencies. The United States did not recognize Haiti until 1862. The country remained diplomatically isolated as Western powers refused to acknowledge a Black republic.
